stage0098b_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「So, this is the isolated universe
　where the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ resides...?」

stage0098b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Aaah!
　A giant naked woman in space!」

stage0098b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'll get you out of here now」

stage0098b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$リーロン$$
「No way!
　It looks like some kind of hologram or something」

stage0098b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ニア$$
「Be careful, $$シモン$$.
　The $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ is far more powerful
　than you think」

stage0098b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't worry!
　I'll win...!
　And once I do, I'm going home to Earth... with you」

stage0098b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Foolish descendants of the Spiral race...
　You who disturb the balance of the universe...」

stage0098b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...」

stage0098b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「To struggle and cling to life is your karma,
　Spiral race... When Spiral life yields
　to evolution's pleasure, this universe faces ruin」

stage0098b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The weight of that sin...
　you shall feel it in your own flesh」

stage0098b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ダリー$$
「We struggled that much against just
　one hand and one foot...!」

stage0098b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ギミー$$
「And there's that many of them...!」

stage0098b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「So this is the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$'s
　homeworld's fighting strength!」

stage0098b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「This is not all」

stage0098b_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Space monsters and $$インベーダー#keyword$$!」

stage0098b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シモン$$
「Does the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ have the power
　to summon $$バアル$$ too!?」

stage0098b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That is not so.
　That one and I share the same goal」

stage0098b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「In other words, I will destroy you
　to protect the order of the universe」

stage0098b_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$キタン$$
「What the hell is that guy talking about!?」

stage0098b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't panic!
　If the enemy's shown itself, all we have
　to do is meet it head-on!」

stage0098b_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$リーロン$$
「$$シモン$$!
　Arc-Gurren is stored inside
　$$超銀河ダイグレン$$ too!」

stage0098b_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$リーロン$$
「When your and $$ダヤッカ$$'s fighting spirit rises,
　$$グレンラガン$$ and $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ become able
　to combine, and $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ is born」

stage0098b_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$リーロン$$
「But be careful.
　$$超銀河ダイグレン$$ counts as a battleship,
　so your current team will end up disbanded」

stage0098b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シモン$$
「Got it!
　I'll combine if I get the chance!」

stage0098b_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Struggling foolishly, are you...
　It seems you truly cannot escape your karma」

stage0098b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$甲児$$
「Seems you don't know what happened
　to those who looked down on us like that before!」

stage0098b_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We've won before!
　Against the black hole incarnate, the $$堕天翅$$ race,
　and the gods of Olympus alike!」

stage0098b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「And so you think you can win again?」

stage0098b_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$n
「That's right...!
　We've always fought believing in hope!」

stage0098b_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Foolish Spiral race...
　Do not think that you alone are special」

stage0098b_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「In the eternal struggle across time
　between us and those who wield Spiral Power,
　countless ones like you have existed」

stage0098b_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「And every one of them fell before us」

stage0098b_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$キタン$$
「Sounds like you're the one who thinks
　you're special!」

stage0098b_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Sounds fun!
　If neither of us knows defeat, let's settle
　who's the strongest in the universe!」

stage0098b_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do this, everyone!
　Knock down anyone who comes at us,
　one after another!」

stage0098b_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$シモン$$
「And then we'll show him!
　The power of us, humanity!!」

stage0098b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Alright!
　The enemy's wiped out!」

stage0098b_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$葵$$
「You want us to fight that huge army again!?」

stage0098b_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't let your spirit break!
　They're aiming for our despair!」

stage0098b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But there's no guarantee that defeating
　the enemy in front of us ends it...!」

stage0098b_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Rotate units for resupply!
　With nowhere to run, all we can do
　is fight!」

stage0098b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Despair, then.
　That is the fate given to you」

stage0098b_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シモン$$
「Like hell we'd give in to something like that!!」

stage0098b_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Isn't there something we can do, $$ロージェノム$$!?」

stage0098b_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「This universe is under the
　$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$'s control.
　And the source of that power is the Death Spiral Machine」

stage0098b_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The warriors of the Spiral race who fell
　in this universe... it absorbs their Spiral Power
　and turns it into whatever energy it desires」

stage0098b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$キタン$$
「If we smash that thing, that bastard's power
　will weaken, right!?」

stage0098b_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The calculation is complete.
　That is the system's core」

stage0098b_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「If you strike that, the system will stop」

stage0098b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$n
「Right in the middle of the enemy...!」

stage0098b_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll break through!
　I'll slip through the gaps between
　those big lugs!」

stage0098b_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Useless.
　At this level of battle, speed means nothing」

stage0098b_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「What's needed is piercing power」

stage0098b_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$リーロン$$
「No, $$シモン$$!
　You're the linchpin of our fighting strength!」

stage0098b_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$隼人$$
「I'll go!
　Leave the drill to me!」

stage0098b_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アンディ$$
「No!
　Digging is my time to shine!!」

stage0098b_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You idiot!
　Don't be so hasty!!」

stage0098b_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$キタン$$
「...nah, I ain't saying some cheesy line
　like that!
　I'm off, you bastards!!」

stage0098b_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$キタン$$
「Here we go!
　This is where it really starts!!」

stage0098b_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$キタン$$
「Don't butt in on $$キタン$$'s
　final big moment!!」

stage0098b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$キタン$$
「Thanks for everything, $$クルツ$$!
　I've got no regrets left!」

stage0098b_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Go, $$キタン$$!
　Don't worry about anything else!!」

stage0098b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$キタン$$
「Yeah!
　Quit drifting around forever
　and settle down already!」

stage0098b_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$キタン$$
「This is $$シモン$$'s!
　The Dai-Gurren Brigade's! Mankind's!
　No, this is MY soul, damn it!!」

stage0098b_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$キタン$$
「Like hell something like you
　could devour me!!」

stage0098b_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$キタン$$
「So this is Spiral Power...!
　Not bad at all... heh heh...!」

stage0098b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'll show you the power
　of $$超銀河グレンラガン$$!!」

stage0098b_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Do it, $$シモン$$!
　Punch clean through them with everything
　you've got!!」

stage0098b_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Amazing...!
　The energy seems to be gushing out endlessly!」

stage0098b_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$n
「This is... the power of the $$スフィア$$...!」

stage0098b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$n
「Here I go, Miss $$スズネ$$!
　With this power, I'll protect Earth's future!」

stage0098b_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Bring it on, $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$, $$バアル$$,
　all of you!
　We've made up our minds to fight to the death too!」

stage0098b_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Mom, $$サチ子$$, $$しげる$$!
　$$かおる$$, Ms. $$美重子$$, Mr. $$大門$$, everyone!
　I'm absolutely not gonna lose!!」

stage0098b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$タケル$$
「Waves of hostility crashing in!
　This is $$バアル$$ and the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$!」

stage0098b_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$タケル$$
「But I won't lose! I mustn't lose!
　Not for the sake of those who believe
　in our victory!!」

stage0098b_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Watch out, $$鉄人$$!
　The enemy's attacking from every direction!」

stage0098b_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't you dare lose!
　We're carrying the hopes of everyone
　on Earth!!」

stage0098b_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of
　letting that world end」

stage0098b_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$桂$$
「Enemies no matter which way I turn...
　what an unwelcome welcoming committee, seriously!」

stage0098b_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$桂$$
「But I saw this coming!
　If you think something this small can take us down,
　I'll show you just how wrong you are!」

stage0098b_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We can't afford to lose!」

stage0098b_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll protect it!
　Our Earth's... humanity's future!!」

stage0098b_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Why...!
　Why does the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ obsess
　this much over our evolution!」

stage0098b_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What does that thing know...!?
　What awaits us further along our path!」

stage0098b_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シャア$$
「Having decided to fight as one man now,
　all I can do is give it my best!」

stage0098b_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シャア$$
「This is the atonement of a man who used war as his means!
　I will protect the future!」

stage0098b_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I will win, no matter what...!」

stage0098b_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$シン$$
「All we want is to live in peace...!
　Why!?」

stage0098b_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シン$$
「Like hell I'll die!
　We're going to live with everything we've got!!」

stage0098b_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$キラ$$
「We fight in order to live...!
　And I will protect everyone's lives!」

stage0098b_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$キラ$$
「No matter who I'm up against, I'll fight!
　That's my resolve!」

stage0098b_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$刹那$$
「This surging malice and hostility...!
　All there is, is to fight!」

stage0098b_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$刹那$$
「There's no choice but to fight!
　To protect the world we live in!!」

stage0098b_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Something like this...!
　How could such senseless violence be forgiven!」

stage0098b_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't afford to lose!
　We'll carve open our own fate with our own hands!!」

stage0098b_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$葵$$
「...The more of a pinch I'm in,
　the more fired up I get.」

stage0098b_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$葵$$
「Come at me from wherever you like!
　I'll knock you all down one by one!!」

stage0098b_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$バサラ$$
「What the hell is this!
　Is killing the enemy all any of you can think about!」

stage0098b_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That kind of thing's worthless!
　Listen to my soooong!!」

stage0098b_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アルト$$
「No matter where I look, there's nothing but enemies!
　No need to even aim!」

stage0098b_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アルト$$
「Let's do this!
　Don't think my wings will break from something like this!!」

stage0098b_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Come at me from wherever, you bastards!
　$$バアル$$, $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$, I'll take you all on at once!!」

stage0098b_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll teach you the strength of a man
　who fights like he's ready to die, until you're sick of it!!」

stage0098b_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Bring it on!
　Don't think a force this puny can crush our fighting spirit!!」

stage0098b_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll show you!
　The pride and grit of us Earthlings, and the strength of me and Mazinger!!」

stage0098b_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$赤木$$
「Like hell I can lose!
　If we lose, who's going to protect the Earth!!」

stage0098b_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'll stake my life on this!
　For everyone on Earth!!」

stage0098b_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A swarm of monsters filling all of space...!
　Now that's a sight straight out of the apocalypse!」

stage0098b_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But there's a future beyond it!
　All that's left is to move toward it!!」

stage0098b_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「No more strategy, no more calculation, not at this point!
　All that's left is to give it everything I have!」

stage0098b_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But I will win, no matter what!
　That's the mission imposed on us!!」

stage0098b_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$宗介$$
「The disparity in strength between us is overwhelming...
　But there is no route of retreat for us...」

stage0098b_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then all that remains is to advance!
　If there is no retreat, we will forge a path forward!」

stage0098b_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I will protect them...!
　The Earth, Altair... the one I love!」

stage0098b_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I have to fight!
　To protect what matters most to me!!」

stage0098b_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「The number of enemies... if we're unlucky,
　it may outnumber our last battle with the space monsters...!」

stage0098b_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Even so, I can't afford to falter!
　Big Sis! Right now, $$ガンバスター$$ and I
　are becoming a flame!!」

stage0098b_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$シモン$$
「Wait for me, $$ニア$$!
　I'm coming to get you right now!」

stage0098b_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シモン$$
「Get out of my way!
　Whether it's $$バアル$$ or $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$,
　don't think you can stop me!!」

stage0098b_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Even I... have something I can do!
　For everyone, for the Earth!」

stage0098b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm going to fight!
　Not because someone told me to, but of my own will!
　To protect someone!!」

stage0098b_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　The enemy's numbers are overwhelming!」

stage0098b_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$n
「I'll show you I can do it!
　I will never let myself be beaten by resignation or despair!」

stage0098b_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「$$ジェニオン$$ has the power for it!
　This power... I'll wield it by my own will!!」

stage0098b_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I don't know what you're saying,
　but I got the spirit behind it, at least!」
